title: Mavzuni chuqur rivojlantirish (Part 3 darajasi)
goal_uz: Dars oxirida Part 3 uslubidagi mavhum savolga bir daqiqa davomida chuqur javob berasiz: sabab va oqibatni zanjir qilib tahlil qilasiz, o‘tmish va kelajakni solishtirasiz, ehtiyotkor umumlashtirasiz va javobni misol hamda e’tiroz bilan kengaytirasiz.

scenes.title: Chuqur javob darsiga xush kelibsiz
board: C2: Developing Topics in Depth
(Mavzuni chuqur rivojlantirish — Part 3)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda diplomatik til va yumshatish vositalarini o‘rgandik: qiyin fikrni muloyim aytishni. Bugun shu ehtiyotkorlikni chuqurlik bilan birlashtiramiz. Sabab va oqibatni tahlil qilish, o‘tmish va kelajakni solishtirish, mavhum umumlashtirish va javobni kengaytirishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida mavhum savolga bir daqiqa davomida mazmunli javob bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Today we move from answering a question to exploring it: causes, consequences, the past, the future and the bigger picture.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz. Bugun savolga shunchaki javob berishdan uni o‘rganishga o‘tamiz: sabablar, oqibatlar, o‘tmish, kelajak va kengroq manzara.

scenes.title: Part 3 nima
board: IELTS Speaking Part 3: discussion, 4–5 minutes
Abstract questions about society, not about you
Criteria: fluency & coherence, vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation

examples.t: Why do you think people read fewer books today?
examples.uz: Sizningcha, nega bugun odamlar kamroq kitob o‘qiydi?

scenes.say_native: IELTS Speaking imtihonining uchinchi qismi to‘rt-besh daqiqalik muhokama. Ikkinchi qismdagi shaxsiy mavzu bilan bog‘liq, lekin savollar mavhum: siz haqingizda emas, jamiyat haqida. Baholash mezonlari to‘rtta: ravonlik va izchillik, lug‘at boyligi, grammatik xilma-xillik va aniqlik, talaffuz. Xuddi shu ko‘nikma ilmiy muhokama va ish yig‘ilishlarida ham kerak.
scenes.say: In Part 3 the examiner asks abstract questions about society. Why do you think people read fewer books today? There is no right answer, only a well-developed one.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi qismda imtihonchi jamiyat haqida mavhum savollar beradi. Sizningcha, nega bugun odamlar kamroq kitob o‘qiydi? To‘g‘ri javob yo‘q, faqat yaxshi rivojlantirilgan javob bor.

scenes.title: Shaxsiydan umumiyga
board: Part 2: I, my family, my town
Part 3: people, society, younger generations
I read on my phone. → Many people now read on screens.

examples.t: Many people now read on screens rather than on paper.
examples.uz: Ko‘p odamlar endi qog‘oz o‘rniga ekranda o‘qiydi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi o‘zgarish nuqtai nazarda. Ikkinchi qismda ‘I’, ‘my family’ deysiz. Uchinchi qismda esa ‘people’, ‘society’, ‘younger generations’ haqida gapirasiz. Shaxsiy tajriba taqiqlanmagan, lekin u faqat misol vazifasini bajaradi. ‘I read on my phone’ o‘rniga ‘Many people now read on screens rather than on paper’, so‘ng zarur bo‘lsa, o‘zingizni misol qilib keltirasiz.
scenes.say: Shift the lens from I to people. Not, I read on my phone, but, many people now read on screens, and I'm a good example of that.
scenes.say_uz: Nigohni ‘men’ dan ‘odamlar’ ga o‘tkazing. ‘Men telefonda o‘qiyman’ emas, ‘ko‘p odamlar endi ekranda o‘qiydi, men ham bunga yaxshi misolman’.

scenes.title: Sabab tili
board: stem from / be rooted in
be driven by / be fuelled by
can be attributed to
a key factor is…

examples.t: The decline in reading can partly be attributed to smartphones.
examples.uz: O‘qishning kamayishini qisman smartfonlarga bog‘lash mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi mavzu: sabab va oqibat. Sabab uchun ‘because’ dan boshqa iboralar kerak. ‘Stem from’ va ‘be rooted in’ chuqur sababni bildiradi. ‘Be driven by’ harakatlantiruvchi kuchni. ‘Can be attributed to’ rasmiyroq va ehtiyotkor. ‘Partly’ qo‘shsangiz, oldingi darsdagi hedging ham ishlaydi: sabab yagona emasligini tan olasiz.
scenes.say: The problem stems from a lack of investment. The trend is largely driven by technology. The decline can partly be attributed to smartphones.
scenes.say_uz: Muammo sarmoya yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi. Bu tendensiyani asosan texnologiya harakatlantiradi. Kamayishni qisman smartfonlarga bog‘lash mumkin.

scenes.title: Oqibat tili
board: lead to / result in + noun
give rise to · trigger · fuel
a knock-on effect on…
which in turn means…

examples.t: Rising rents have had a knock-on effect on small businesses.
examples.uz: Ijara narxining oshishi kichik bizneslarga zanjirli ta’sir ko‘rsatdi.

scenes.say_native: Oqibat uchun: ‘lead to’ va ‘result in’, ikkalasidan keyin ot keladi. ‘Give rise to’ yangi muammo paydo bo‘lishini bildiradi. ‘Fuel’ mavjud jarayonni kuchaytiradi. ‘Knock-on effect’ ikkilamchi, zanjirli ta’sir. ‘Which in turn means’ esa oqibatdan keyingi oqibatga o‘tish uchun eng foydali ibora.
scenes.say: Rising rents have led to the closure of many shops, which in turn means fewer local jobs.
scenes.say_uz: Ijara narxining oshishi ko‘p do‘konlarning yopilishiga olib keldi, bu esa o‘z navbatida mahalliy ish o‘rinlari kamayishini anglatadi.

scenes.title: Sabab-oqibat zanjiri
board: Cause → Effect → Further effect
Urbanisation → more jobs in cities → villages lose young people
→ which in turn puts pressure on rural services
scenes.say_native: Chuqurlik zanjirdan keladi. Oddiy javob bitta bog‘lanishda to‘xtaydi: ‘People move to cities for jobs.’ Chuqur javob davom etadi: ish shaharda, yoshlar ketadi, qishloqlarda asosan keksalar qoladi, bu esa o‘z navbatida qishloqdagi xizmatlarga bosim tushiradi. Har bir halqa yangi fikr qo‘shadi, takror emas.
scenes.say: People move to cities for work, so villages lose their young people, which in turn puts pressure on rural schools.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar ish uchun shaharlarga ko‘chadi, shuning uchun qishloqlar yoshlarini yo‘qotadi, bu esa o‘z navbatida qishloq maktablariga bosim tushiradi.

scenes.title: Sabab-oqibat xatolari
board: ✗ due to people are busy → ✓ because people are busy
✗ It leads to increase → ✓ It leads to an increase
✗ result of (= cause) → ✓ result in (= cause)
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchi: ‘due to’ dan keyin to‘liq gap emas, ot keladi: ‘due to their busy lives’ yoki ‘because people are busy’. Ikkinchi: ‘lead to’ dan keyin artiklni unutmang: ‘an increase’. Uchinchi: ‘result in’ oqibatni, ‘result from’ sababni bildiradi. Ularni almashtirsangiz, fikringiz teskari bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: Due to their busy lives, not due to people are busy. It leads to an increase. And stress results from overwork, while overwork results in stress.
scenes.say_uz: Band hayotlari tufayli, ‘due to people are busy’ emas. Bu o‘sishga olib keladi. Stress ortiqcha ishdan kelib chiqadi, ortiqcha ish esa stressga olib keladi.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri bog‘lovchini tanlang
board: 1) Obesity partly ___ poor diet. (stems from / results in)
2) Cheap flights have ___ mass tourism. (given rise to / resulted from)
3) ___ rising costs, many cafés closed. (Due to / Because)
4) Fewer jobs, ___ means less spending. (which in turn / in turn which)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap, har birida ikkita variant. Ma’noga qarang: qayerda sabab, qayerda oqibat? Va grammatikaga qarang: bog‘lovchidan keyin ot keladimi yoki to‘liq gap? Javobni butun gap bilan ovoz chiqarib ayting. Har bir to‘g‘ri javob uchun sababini ham o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Choose the right option in each sentence. Read each one aloud in full.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapda to‘g‘ri variantni tanlang. Har birini to‘liq ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) stems from · 2) given rise to
3) Due to (+ noun) · 4) which in turn
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: stems from, chunki noto‘g‘ri ovqatlanish sabab. Ikkinchi: given rise to, arzon reyslar ommaviy turizmni keltirib chiqargan. Uchinchi: due to, chunki keyin ot birikmasi keladi: ‘rising costs’. ‘Because’ bo‘lsa, ‘because costs were rising’ kerak edi. To‘rtinchi: which in turn, tartib aynan shunday.
scenes.say: Stems from. Given rise to. Due to, because a noun phrase follows. And which in turn.
scenes.say_uz: Stems from. Given rise to. Due to, chunki keyin ot birikmasi keladi. Va which in turn.

scenes.title: Zanjir quring
board: Why do so many young people move to big cities?
cause → effect → further effect
30 seconds
scenes.say_native: Endi og‘zaki. Savol: nega ko‘p yoshlar katta shaharlarga ko‘chadi? O‘ttiz soniya ichida kamida uch halqali zanjir quring: sabab, oqibat va undan keyingi oqibat. ‘Stem from’, ‘lead to’ va ‘which in turn’ iboralarini ishlatishga harakat qiling. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: Why do so many young people move to big cities? Build a chain of at least three links in thirty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Nega ko‘p yoshlar katta shaharlarga ko‘chadi? O‘ttiz soniyada kamida uch halqali zanjir quring.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: is largely driven by…
This leads to…
which in turn…
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang. Unda sabab, oqibat va ikkilamchi oqibat bor, hamda ‘largely’ so‘zi bilan ehtiyotkorlik saqlangan. Javobingizni solishtiring: zanjiringizda nechta halqa bor edi va har bir halqa yangi fikr qo‘shdimi? Agar uchta bo‘lsa, siz to‘g‘ri yo‘ldasiz.
scenes.say: I'd say it's largely driven by opportunity. Universities and well-paid jobs are concentrated in cities. This leads to a steady outflow from rural areas, which in turn makes it harder for villages to keep their schools and services running.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, bu asosan imkoniyatlar bilan bog‘liq. Universitetlar va yaxshi maoshli ishlar shaharlarda to‘plangan. Bu qishloqlardan doimiy ketishga olib keladi, bu esa o‘z navbatida qishloqlarga maktab va xizmatlarni saqlab qolishni qiyinlashtiradi.

scenes.title: O‘tmish bilan solishtirish
board: used to / would (past habits)
no longer · back then · a generation ago
Present perfect for change: has become, have grown
There has been a shift towards…

examples.t: There has been a marked shift towards online shopping.
examples.uz: Onlayn xaridga sezilarli siljish yuz berdi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: o‘tmish va kelajak. O‘tmishdagi odat uchun ‘used to’ va ‘would’: ‘People used to shop at local markets.’ O‘zgarishni bildirish uchun present perfect: ‘Shopping has become far more convenient.’ ‘There has been a shift towards’ iborasi esa tendensiyani rasmiy tasvirlaydi. O‘zbekchada ‘ilgari … edi, endi …’ deymiz, inglizchada zamon tanlovi bu ma’noni beradi.
scenes.say: People used to shop at local markets. Since then, there has been a marked shift towards online shopping.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar mahalliy bozorlarda xarid qilishardi. O‘shandan beri onlayn xaridga sezilarli siljish yuz berdi.

scenes.title: Kelajak haqida taxmin
board: is likely to / is bound to / is set to
In all likelihood… · I'd imagine…
will be doing (future continuous)
will have done (future perfect)

examples.t: By the time our children are adults, cash will have largely disappeared.
examples.uz: Farzandlarimiz voyaga yetguncha naqd pul deyarli yo‘qolib bo‘ladi.

scenes.say_native: Kelajak uchun ‘will’ dan boyroq vositalar. ‘Is likely to’ ehtimolni, ‘is bound to’ deyarli aniqlikni bildiradi. ‘In all likelihood’ va ‘I’d imagine’ ehtiyotkor taxmin. Future continuous kelajakdagi jarayon: ‘We’ll be working from home.’ Future perfect ma’lum vaqtgacha tugagan harakat: ‘Cash will have largely disappeared.’ Bu zamonlar C2 nutqini darhol boyitadi.
scenes.say: In all likelihood, more of us will be working from home. And by the time our children are adults, cash will have largely disappeared.
scenes.say_uz: Katta ehtimol bilan ko‘pchiligimiz uydan ishlayotgan bo‘lamiz. Farzandlarimiz voyaga yetguncha esa naqd pul deyarli yo‘qolib bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Solishtirish tuzilmalari
board: far more / considerably less than
not nearly as… as
The more…, the more…
whereas / while

examples.t: The more we rely on apps, the less we remember.
examples.uz: Ilovalarga qancha ko‘p tayansak, shuncha kam eslab qolamiz.

scenes.say_native: Solishtirish uchun kuchli tuzilmalar. ‘Far more’, ‘considerably less’ farqning darajasini ko‘rsatadi. ‘Not nearly as … as’ katta farqni muloyim aytadi. ‘The more…, the more…’ ikki jarayonni bog‘laydi. ‘Whereas’ esa ikki davrni qarama-qarshi qo‘yadi: ‘Back then, families ate together, whereas now meals are often eaten on the go.’
scenes.say: The more we rely on apps, the less we remember. Back then, families ate together, whereas now meals are often eaten on the go.
scenes.say_uz: Ilovalarga qancha ko‘p tayansak, shuncha kam eslab qolamiz. Ilgari oilalar birga ovqatlanardi, hozir esa ko‘pincha yo‘l-yo‘lakay ovqatlaniladi.

scenes.title: Zamon xatolari
board: ✗ In past, people… → ✓ In the past, people…
✗ Nowadays people are become… → ✓ have become
✗ People would have more free time. (state) → ✓ used to have
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchi: ‘in past’ emas, artikl bilan ‘in the past’. Ikkinchi: o‘zgarish uchun present perfect: ‘people have become’. ‘Are become’ degan shakl yo‘q. Uchinchi: ‘would’ faqat takrorlanadigan harakatlar uchun, holat uchun emas. ‘People would have more free time’ shartli gapdek eshitiladi; to‘g‘risi ‘people used to have’.
scenes.say: In the past, people used to have more free time. Nowadays, people have become far busier.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tmishda odamlarning bo‘sh vaqti ko‘proq edi. Hozir odamlar ancha band bo‘lib qolgan.

scenes.title: O‘tmish va kelajakni solishtiring
board: 1) people / write letters (past habit)
2) shift / online learning (change)
3) robots / do most factory work by 2050? (future perfect)
4) cities / large / now vs then (not nearly as)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta topshiriq. Har birida berilgan so‘zlar va qavsdagi tuzilma bilan gap tuzing. Birinchisida o‘tmishdagi odat, ikkinchisida o‘zgarish, uchinchisida future perfect, to‘rtinchisida ‘not nearly as … as’. Gaplarni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Har bir gapni ikki marta ayting.
scenes.say: Make four sentences using the prompts and the structures in brackets.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rsatmalar va qavsdagi tuzilmalardan foydalanib to‘rtta gap tuzing.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) People used to write letters to each other.
2) There has been a shift towards online learning.
3) By 2050, robots will have taken over most factory work.
4) Towns then were not nearly as large as cities are now.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. ‘People used to write letters to each other.’ ‘There has been a shift towards online learning.’ ‘By 2050, robots will have taken over most factory work’, bu yerda future perfect va ‘take over’ frazali fe’li. ‘Towns then were not nearly as large as cities are now.’ Uchinchi gap taxmin, shuning uchun ‘in all likelihood’ qo‘shsangiz, yanada ehtiyotkor bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: People used to write letters. There has been a shift towards online learning. By 2050, robots will have taken over most factory work. Towns then were not nearly as large.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar xat yozishardi. Onlayn ta’limga siljish yuz berdi. 2050-yilga kelib robotlar zavod ishlarining ko‘pini egallab bo‘ladi. O‘sha paytdagi shaharchalar unchalik katta emas edi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: xarid odatlari
board: Part 3 exchange: shopping habits
Listen for: past, present, future
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Imtihonchi nomzoddan xarid odatlari qanday o‘zgargani haqida so‘rayapti. Nomzod o‘tmishni, hozirni va kelajakni qanday bog‘laganini kuzating. Qaysi zamonlar va qaysi solishtirish iboralari ishlatilganiga e’tibor bering. Yozib olsangiz ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Examiner: How have shopping habits changed in your country? Candidate: Quite dramatically. A generation ago, people would go to the bazaar several times a week, and shopping was a social event. These days, there's been a clear shift towards supermarkets and, increasingly, online orders. Examiner: And in the future? Candidate: I'd imagine the bazaar will survive, but more as a cultural experience than a necessity. Convenience is bound to win for everyday items.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihonchi: Mamlakatingizda xarid odatlari qanday o‘zgardi? Nomzod: Ancha keskin. Bir avlod oldin odamlar haftasiga bir necha marta bozorga borishardi, xarid ijtimoiy tadbir edi. Hozir supermarketlarga va tobora ko‘proq onlayn buyurtmalarga aniq siljish bor. Imtihonchi: Kelajakda-chi? Nomzod: Menimcha, bozor saqlanib qoladi, lekin zarurat emas, ko‘proq madaniy tajriba sifatida. Kundalik narsalar uchun qulaylik albatta g‘olib chiqadi.

scenes.title: Suhbatni tushundingizmi?
board: 1) What did shopping use to be like?
2) What shift does the candidate describe?
3) What will happen to the bazaar?
4) Which structure shows a past habit?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Ilgari xarid qanday bo‘lgan? Nomzod qanday siljishni tasvirladi? Uning fikricha, bozorning kelajagi qanday? Va o‘tmishdagi odatni qaysi grammatik tuzilma bildirdi? Javoblarni inglizcha, qisqa ayting. Kerak bo‘lsa, suhbatni xayolan qayta eslang va kalit so‘zlarni toping.
scenes.say: What did shopping use to be like? What shift does the candidate describe? What will happen to the bazaar? Which structure shows a past habit?
scenes.say_uz: Ilgari xarid qanday edi? Nomzod qanday siljishni tasvirlaydi? Bozor bilan nima bo‘ladi? Qaysi tuzilma o‘tmishdagi odatni ko‘rsatadi?

scenes.title: Suhbat javoblari
board: 1) frequent bazaar visits; a social event
2) towards supermarkets and online orders
3) survive as a cultural experience
4) people would go…
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ilgari odamlar haftasiga bir necha marta bozorga borgan, xarid ijtimoiy tadbir bo‘lgan. Siljish supermarketlar va onlayn buyurtmalar tomon. Bozor zarurat sifatida emas, madaniy tajriba sifatida saqlanadi. O‘tmishdagi odatni ‘would go’ bildirdi. Kelajak uchun ‘I’d imagine’ va ‘is bound to’ ishlatilgani ham diqqatga sazovor.
scenes.say: A social trip to the bazaar. A shift to supermarkets and online orders. The bazaar survives as culture. And would go showed the habit.
scenes.say_uz: Bozorga ijtimoiy tashrif. Supermarket va onlayn buyurtmalarga siljish. Bozor madaniyat sifatida saqlanadi. Odatni ‘would go’ ko‘rsatdi.

scenes.title: Umumlashtirish tili
board: by and large · on the whole · broadly speaking
tend to · there is a tendency for…
to some extent · in many cases · this varies

examples.t: On the whole, older people tend to be more cautious online.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, keksalar internetda ehtiyotkorroq bo‘lishga moyil.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: mavhum umumlashtirish. Jamiyat haqida gapirganda, ‘all’ yoki ‘always’ xavfli. Buning o‘rniga: ‘by and large’, ‘on the whole’, ‘broadly speaking’. ‘Tend to’ fe’li juda foydali: ‘Older people tend to be more cautious.’ Cheklovlar: ‘to some extent’, ‘in many cases’. Bu oldingi darsdagi hedging ning ilmiy muhokamadagi ko‘rinishi.
scenes.say: By and large, people value convenience. Older people tend to be more cautious online.
scenes.say_uz: Umuman olganda, odamlar qulaylikni qadrlaydi. Keksalar internetda ehtiyotkorroq bo‘lishga moyil.

scenes.title: Artikllar va umumlashtirish
board: Plural / uncountable, no article: Technology changes how people live.
the + singular = the whole class: The smartphone has transformed…
the + adjective = group: the elderly, the young, the unemployed

examples.t: The smartphone has transformed the way we communicate.

scenes.say_native: Umumlashtirishda artikllar hal qiluvchi. Ko‘plik yoki sanalmaydigan otda artikl yo‘q: ‘Technology changes how people live.’ ‘The’ bilan birlik ot butun turni bildiradi: ‘The smartphone has transformed communication.’ ‘The’ va sifat guruhni: ‘the elderly’, ‘the young’. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun bu joyda xato juda ko‘p.
scenes.say: Technology changes how people live. The smartphone has transformed communication. And society should do more for the elderly.
scenes.say_uz: Texnologiya odamlarning yashash tarzini o‘zgartiradi. Smartfon muloqotni tubdan o‘zgartirdi. Jamiyat keksalar uchun ko‘proq ish qilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Umumlashtirishdagi artikl xatolari
board: ✗ The technology changes the people. → ✓ Technology changes people.
✗ Elderly need support. → ✓ The elderly need support.
✗ The life is harder now. → ✓ Life is harder now.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar. ‘The technology changes the people’: umumiy ma’noda ikkala ‘the’ ortiqcha. ‘Elderly need support’: guruhni bildirish uchun ‘the elderly’ kerak. ‘The life is harder now’: hayot umuman olganda, shuning uchun artiklsiz ‘life’. Rus tilini biladiganlar ham bu yerda adashadi, chunki rus tilida ham artikl yo‘q.
scenes.say: Technology changes people. The elderly need support. Life is harder now.
scenes.say_uz: Texnologiya odamlarni o‘zgartiradi. Keksalarga yordam kerak. Hozir hayot qiyinroq.

scenes.title: Artiklni qo‘ying
board: 1) ___ education is the key to ___ progress.
2) ___ internet has changed ___ politics.
3) We should protect ___ environment.
4) ___ young are often blamed for everything.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Har bir bo‘sh joyga ‘the’ yoki artiklsiz variantni tanlang. O‘ylang: bu umumiy tushunchami, butun turmi yoki yagona narsami? Diqqat: ba’zi otlar an’anaviy ravishda ‘the’ bilan ishlatiladi. Javobingizni butun gap bilan ayting. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: The or no article? Say each sentence in full.
scenes.say_uz: The kerakmi yoki artiklsizmi? Har bir gapni to‘liq ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Education is the key to progress. (no articles)
2) The internet has changed politics.
3) …protect the environment.
4) The young are often blamed…
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ‘Education’ va ‘progress’ umumiy tushunchalar, artikl kerak emas. Ikkinchi: ‘the internet’, chunki u yagona tizim, lekin ‘politics’ umumiy, artiklsiz. Uchinchi: ‘the environment’, u ham yagona deb qaraladi. To‘rtinchi: ‘the young’, the va sifat guruhni bildiradi. Bu qoidalarni nutqda avtomatlashtiring.
scenes.say: Education is the key to progress. The internet has changed politics. We should protect the environment. The young are often blamed for everything.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’lim taraqqiyot kaliti. Internet siyosatni o‘zgartirdi. Atrof-muhitni himoya qilishimiz kerak. Yoshlar ko‘pincha hamma narsada ayblanadi.

scenes.title: Mavhum otlar
board: the rise of / the decline of
the erosion of trust
a sense of community
individualism · consumerism · inequality

examples.t: Social media has contributed to the erosion of trust in experts.
examples.uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar mutaxassislarga ishonchning yemirilishiga hissa qo‘shdi.

scenes.say_native: Mavhum fikr mavhum otlarni talab qiladi. ‘The rise of’, ‘the decline of’, ‘the erosion of trust’, ya’ni ishonchning asta-sekin yemirilishi. ‘A sense of community’, jamoaviylik hissi. ‘Individualism’, ‘consumerism’, ‘inequality’. Bunday otlar bilan bitta ibora butun bir jarayonni nomlaydi va javobingiz akademik ohang oladi.
scenes.say: We've seen the rise of remote work, the decline of the high street and, some say, the erosion of trust.
scenes.say_uz: Masofaviy ishning o‘sishi, markaziy ko‘chalar savdosining pasayishi va, ba’zilar aytishicha, ishonchning yemirilishini ko‘rdik.

scenes.title: Mavhumdan aniqqa va qaytish
board: Abstract: a weaker sense of community
Concrete: Take my street, for instance…
Back: …which shows how individualism has grown.
scenes.say_native: Chuqur javob mavhumlik zinapoyasida yuqoriga va pastga harakatlanadi. Avval mavhum fikr: ‘a weaker sense of community’. Keyin aniq misol: ‘Take my street, for instance.’ So‘ng yana umumiy xulosaga qaytish. Faqat mavhum javob quruq, faqat misol esa sayoz eshitiladi. Ikkalasining birikmasi chuqurlik beradi.
scenes.say: There's a weaker sense of community. Take my street: neighbours once shared meals, whereas now we barely know each other's names. That shows how individualism has grown.
scenes.say_uz: Jamoaviylik hissi zaiflashgan. Mening ko‘chamni olaylik: qo‘shnilar bir paytlar birga ovqatlanardi, hozir esa bir-birimizning ismini zo‘rg‘a bilamiz. Bu individualizm qanchalik kuchayganini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Haddan tashqari umumlashtirish
board: ✗ All young people are addicted to their phones.
✓ A great many young people seem to spend…
✗ Everybody knows that… · Always · Never
scenes.say_native: Umumlashtirish va mubolag‘a turli narsa. ‘All young people are addicted to their phones’ yoki ‘Everybody knows that’ oddiy va ishonchsiz eshitiladi, imtihonchi buni mantiqiy zaiflik deb biladi. Yaxshisi: ‘A great many young people seem to spend a lot of time on their phones.’ Qat’iylik emas, aniqlik kuch beradi.
scenes.say: Not, all young people are addicted to their phones, but, a great many young people seem to spend a lot of time on them.
scenes.say_uz: ‘Barcha yoshlar telefoniga qaram’ emas, ‘juda ko‘p yoshlar telefonda ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazadiganga o‘xshaydi’.

scenes.title: Umumiy fikrga aylantiring
board: 1) My grandmother doesn't trust online banking.
2) My friends never read newspapers.
3) Everyone in my office works late.
scenes.say_native: Uchta shaxsiy yoki mubolag‘ali gap. Har birini ehtiyotkor umumlashtirishga aylantiring. ‘Tend to’, ‘on the whole’, ‘many’ kabi vositalardan va guruh nomlaridan, masalan, ‘the elderly’ yoki ‘younger people’ dan foydalaning. Xohlasangiz, shaxsiy tajribani misol sifatida qoldiring.
scenes.say: Generalise carefully. My grandmother doesn't trust online banking. My friends never read newspapers. Everyone in my office works late.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyotkor umumlashtiring. Buvim onlayn bankka ishonmaydi. Do‘stlarim hech qachon gazeta o‘qimaydi. Ofisimdagi hamma kech ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) Older people tend to be wary of online banking.
2) On the whole, younger people rarely read printed newspapers.
3) Long working hours seem to be increasingly common.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. ‘Older people tend to be wary of online banking; my grandmother is a case in point.’ ‘On the whole, younger people rarely read printed newspapers.’ ‘Long working hours seem to be increasingly common, at least in office jobs.’ Har birida guruh nomi, ehtiyotkor fe’l va cheklov bor.
scenes.say: Older people tend to be wary of online banking; my grandmother is a case in point. On the whole, younger people rarely read printed newspapers. Long working hours seem to be increasingly common, at least in office jobs.
scenes.say_uz: Keksalar onlayn bankdan ehtiyot bo‘lishga moyil; buvim bunga yaxshi misol. Umuman olganda, yoshlar bosma gazetalarni kamdan-kam o‘qiydi. Uzoq ish soatlari, hech bo‘lmaganda ofis ishlarida, tobora odatiy bo‘lib borayotganga o‘xshaydi.

scenes.title: Javobni kengaytirish sxemasi
board: 1) Answer (clear position)
2) Reason (cause / explanation)
3) Example (concrete)
4) Concession → 5) Conclusion / future
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: javobni chuqur kengaytirish. Foydali sxema besh qadamdan iborat: aniq pozitsiya, sabab, aniq misol, qarama-qarshi fikrni tan olish va xulosa yoki kelajakka nazar. Bu shablon emas, fikrlash tartibi: har safar so‘zlar boshqacha bo‘ladi. Shu besh qadam bir daqiqalik javobga tabiiy shakl beradi.
scenes.say: A strong answer often moves through five steps: a clear position, a reason, a concrete example, a concession, and a conclusion that looks ahead.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli javob ko‘pincha besh qadamdan o‘tadi: aniq pozitsiya, sabab, aniq misol, yon berish va kelajakka nazar tashlaydigan xulosa.

scenes.title: Yon berish iboralari
board: Admittedly, … · That said, …
Having said that, …
While it's true that…, …
On the other hand, …

examples.t: While it's true that apps save time, they can also make us passive.
examples.uz: Ilovalar vaqtni tejashi rost, lekin ular bizni passiv ham qilishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Yon berish, ya’ni qarama-qarshi fikrni tan olish, javobga etuklik beradi. ‘Admittedly’, ‘That said’, ‘Having said that’, ‘While it’s true that…’. Siz boshqa tomonni ko‘rganingizni ko‘rsatasiz, keyin o‘z pozitsiyangizga qaytasiz. Bu oldingi darsdagi diplomatiya bilan ham bog‘liq: fikringiz kuchli, lekin bir tomonlama emas.
scenes.say: Admittedly, online learning is cheaper. That said, it can be isolating. While it's true that apps save time, they can also make us passive.
scenes.say_uz: Tan olish kerakki, onlayn ta’lim arzonroq. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, u yolg‘izlantirishi mumkin. Ilovalar vaqtni tejashi rost, lekin ular bizni passiv ham qilishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Tabiiy vaqt yutish
board: That's a big question.
It's not something I've given much thought to, but…
I suppose it depends on…
✗ long memorised fillers
scenes.say_native: Mavhum savol kutilmaganda kelsa, tabiiy ravishda vaqt yuting: ‘That’s a big question’, ‘It’s not something I’ve given much thought to, but…’, ‘I suppose it depends on…’. Oxirgisi ayniqsa foydali, chunki u darhol tahlilni boshlaydi. Lekin uzun yodlangan to‘ldiruvchilardan qoching: imtihonchi ularni sezadi va ravonlik balingiz tushadi.
scenes.say: That's a big question. I suppose it depends on what we mean by success. It's not something I've given much thought to, but I'd say…
scenes.say_uz: Bu katta savol. Menimcha, muvaffaqiyat deganda nimani tushunishimizga bog‘liq. Bu haqda ko‘p o‘ylamaganman, lekin aytishim mumkinki…

scenes.title: Talaffuz: fikr guruhlari va bog‘lanish
board: Pause between thought groups: Admittedly, | it's cheaper. |
Linking: a lot of /ə ˈlɒt əv/ · in turn /ɪn ˈtɜːn/
Stress the contrast: ONline vs FACE-to-face
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz nuqtasi. Uzun javobda pauzalarni fikr guruhlari orasiga qo‘ying, so‘zlar orasiga emas. ‘Admittedly’ dan keyin qisqa pauza, keyin gap. So‘zlarni bog‘lang: ‘a lot of’ /ə ˈlɒt əv/ bo‘lib eshitiladi, ‘of’ zaif shaklda. Qarama-qarshilikda urg‘u kontrast so‘zlarga tushadi: ‘ONline’ va ‘FACE-to-face’. Bu tinglovchiga tuzilmani eshitishga yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Admittedly, online courses are cheaper. Having said that, face-to-face learning offers a lot of things a screen can't.
scenes.say_uz: Tan olish kerakki, onlayn kurslar arzonroq. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, yuzma-yuz ta’lim ekran bera olmaydigan ko‘p narsalarni taklif qiladi.

scenes.title: Sayoz javob
board: ✗ Yes, I think so, because it is good.
✓ position + reason + example + concession + conclusion
Depth ≠ length: no repetition
scenes.say_native: Sayoz javobning namunasi: ‘Yes, I think so, because it is good.’ Bu yerda sabab ham, misol ham, mavhum tahlil ham yo‘q. Lekin teskari xato ham bor: bir fikrni boshqa so‘zlar bilan uch marta takrorlab, javobni uzun qilish. Chuqurlik uzunlik emas: har bir gap yangi narsa qo‘shishi kerak.
scenes.say: Depth is not the same as length. Every sentence should add a reason, an example, a contrast or a consequence, not repeat the last one.
scenes.say_uz: Chuqurlik uzunlik bilan bir xil emas. Har bir gap oldingisini takrorlamay, sabab, misol, qarama-qarshilik yoki oqibat qo‘shishi kerak.

scenes.title: Tinglash: namunaviy chuqur javob
board: Question: Will more people work from home in the future?
Listen for the five steps
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Nomzod ‘Kelajakda ko‘proq odamlar uydan ishlaydimi?’ degan savolga javob beryapti. Besh qadamni topishga harakat qiling: pozitsiya, sabab, misol, yon berish va xulosa. Qaysi iboralar har bir qadamni boshlab berganiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: I think so, yes, at least for office work. The main reason is that the technology is now cheap and reliable. Take my brother's company, for instance: it gave up half its office space and productivity barely changed. Admittedly, not every job can be done remotely, and some people miss the social side. That said, I'd imagine hybrid working will have become the norm within a decade.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, menimcha, hech bo‘lmaganda ofis ishlari uchun. Asosiy sabab, texnologiya endi arzon va ishonchli. Masalan, akamning kompaniyasini olaylik: u ofis maydonining yarmidan voz kechdi va samaradorlik deyarli o‘zgarmadi. Tan olish kerakki, har bir ishni masofadan bajarib bo‘lmaydi va ba’zilar ijtimoiy tomonni sog‘inadi. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, menimcha, o‘n yil ichida gibrid ish odatiy holga aylanib bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Besh qadamni toping
board: 1) Position? · 2) Reason?
3) Example? · 4) Concession?
5) Conclusion? Which tense?
scenes.say_native: Endi tahlil qiling. Nomzodning pozitsiyasi qanday edi? Qanday sabab keltirdi? Qanday misol berdi? Qaysi ibora bilan yon berdi? Va xulosada qaysi zamon ishlatildi? Javoblarni inglizcha ayting, iloji boricha aniq iboralar bilan. Har bir qadam uchun bitta ibora yetarli.
scenes.say: Find the five steps. What was the position, the reason, the example and the concession? And which tense appears in the conclusion?
scenes.say_uz: Besh qadamni toping. Pozitsiya, sabab, misol va yon berish nima edi? Xulosada qaysi zamon bor?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: Position: I think so, at least for office work.
Reason: cheap, reliable technology · Example: brother's company
Concession: Admittedly, not every job…
Conclusion: will have become the norm (future perfect)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Pozitsiya: ‘I think so, at least for office work’, bu yerda cheklov ham bor. Sabab: arzon va ishonchli texnologiya. Misol: akasining kompaniyasi, ‘Take…, for instance’ bilan. Yon berish: ‘Admittedly, not every job can be done remotely.’ Xulosa: ‘That said’, keyin future perfect: ‘will have become the norm’. Bitta javobda bugungi barcha vositalar.
scenes.say: Position: at least for office work. Reason: cheap technology. Example: his brother's company. Concession: admittedly. Conclusion: will have become the norm.
scenes.say_uz: Pozitsiya: hech bo‘lmaganda ofis ishlari uchun. Sabab: arzon texnologiya. Misol: akasining kompaniyasi. Yon berish: admittedly. Xulosa: will have become the norm.

scenes.title: Sayoz javobni chuqurlashtiring
board: Q: Does technology improve education?
Weak: Yes, because it is useful.
Add: reason, example, concession, conclusion
scenes.say_native: Sayoz javob: ‘Yes, because it is useful.’ Uni besh qadamli javobga aylantiring. Avval pozitsiyani cheklov bilan aniqlang, keyin aniq sabab va misol keltiring, yon bering va kelajakka nazar bilan yakunlang. Taxminan qirq soniya gapiring. Shoshilmang. Boshlang.
scenes.say: Does technology improve education? Turn this weak answer into a strong one: yes, because it is useful.
scenes.say_uz: Texnologiya ta’limni yaxshilaydimi? Bu sayoz javobni kuchli javobga aylantiring: ha, chunki foydali.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: To a large extent, yes…
It gives access to…
Take…, for instance
Having said that… · In the long run…
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang va solishtiring. Pozitsiya ‘to a large extent’ bilan cheklangan, sabab aniq, misol mahalliy va real, yon berish ‘having said that’ bilan, xulosa esa ‘in the long run’ bilan kelajakka qaraydi. ‘Useful’ so‘zi umuman ishlatilmadi: o‘rniga aniq foyda nomlandi.
scenes.say: To a large extent, yes. It gives students access to resources that used to be available only in big cities. Take online courses, for instance: a student in a small town can now attend lectures from leading universities. Having said that, a screen can't replace a good teacher. In the long run, I'd imagine the best results will come from combining the two.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p jihatdan, ha. U talabalarga ilgari faqat katta shaharlarda bo‘lgan resurslardan foydalanish imkonini beradi. Masalan, onlayn kurslarni olaylik: kichik shahardagi talaba endi yetakchi universitetlar ma’ruzalarida qatnasha oladi. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, ekran yaxshi o‘qituvchining o‘rnini bosa olmaydi. Uzoq muddatda, menimcha, eng yaxshi natija ikkalasini birlashtirishdan keladi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bir daqiqa
board: How has the role of the family changed,
and how might it change in the future?
1 minute: cause, past vs future, generalise, extend
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Savol: oilaning roli qanday o‘zgardi va kelajakda qanday o‘zgarishi mumkin? Bir daqiqa gapiring. Bugungi to‘rt vositani birlashtiring: sabab va oqibat zanjiri, o‘tmish va kelajak solishtiruvi, ehtiyotkor umumlashtirish va besh qadamli kengaytirish. Iloji bo‘lsa, javobingizni yozib oling.
scenes.say: How has the role of the family changed, and how might it change in the future? Speak for one minute.
scenes.say_uz: Oilaning roli qanday o‘zgardi va kelajakda qanday o‘zgarishi mumkin? Bir daqiqa gapiring.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: used to · has shrunk
largely driven by… which in turn…
Admittedly… · That said…
is likely to…
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang. Unda o‘tmishdagi odat, present perfect bilan o‘zgarish, sabab-oqibat zanjiri, yon berish va kelajak taxmini bor. Lekin u yodlangan shablonga o‘xshamaydi, chunki har bir gap oldingisidan tabiiy kelib chiqadi. O‘z javobingizni shu mezonlar bo‘yicha baholang.
scenes.say: In Uzbekistan, several generations used to live under one roof. Broadly speaking, the household has shrunk, largely driven by urbanisation, which in turn means grandparents play a smaller daily role. Admittedly, family ties are still very strong here. That said, I'd imagine the family is likely to become more of an emotional network than an economic unit.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbekistonda bir necha avlod bir tom ostida yashardi. Umuman olganda, xonadon kichraydi, bunga asosan urbanizatsiya sabab bo‘ldi, bu esa o‘z navbatida buvi-bobolarning kundalik roli kamayishini anglatadi. Tan olish kerakki, bu yerda oilaviy rishtalar hali ham juda kuchli. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, menimcha, oila iqtisodiy birlikdan ko‘ra ko‘proq hissiy tarmoqqa aylanishi ehtimoli bor.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: 1) Causes & consequences: stem from, lead to, which in turn
2) Past vs future: used to, has become, will have done
3) Generalise: tend to, by and large, articles
4) Extend: position, reason, example, concession, conclusion
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: sabab va oqibatni zanjir qilib bog‘lang: stem from, lead to, which in turn. Ikkinchi: o‘tmish va kelajakni solishtiring: used to, present perfect, future perfect. Uchinchi: ehtiyotkor umumlashtiring va artikllarga e’tibor bering. To‘rtinchi: javobni besh qadam bilan kengaytiring va takrordan qoching.
scenes.say: Chain causes and consequences. Compare past and future with the right tenses. Generalise carefully. And extend every answer with reasons, examples and concessions.
scenes.say_uz: Sabab va oqibatlarni zanjir qiling. O‘tmish va kelajakni to‘g‘ri zamonlar bilan solishtiring. Ehtiyotkor umumlashtiring. Har bir javobni sabab, misol va yon berish bilan kengaytiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: answer 4 Part 3 questions, 1 minute each
Record yourself · check the five steps
Next: public speaking and debate
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: to‘rtta Part 3 uslubidagi savolga har biriga bir daqiqadan javob bering, masalan, ta’lim, texnologiya, shahar hayoti va atrof-muhit haqida. Javoblaringizni yozib oling va tinglang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir javob kamida ellik soniya davom etadi va besh qadamning kamida to‘rttasi aniq eshitiladi. Keyingi darsda ommaviy nutq va debatni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Answer four Part 3 questions for one minute each, record yourself and check for the five steps. Next time: public speaking and debate.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta Part 3 savoliga har biriga bir daqiqadan javob bering, o‘zingizni yozib oling va besh qadamni tekshiring. Keyingi safar: ommaviy nutq va debat.

homework_uz: To‘rtta Part 3 uslubidagi savolga (masalan, ta’lim, texnologiya, shahar hayoti va atrof-muhit haqida) har biriga bir daqiqadan og‘zaki javob bering va javoblaringizni yozib oling. Har bir javobda sabab-oqibat, o‘tmish yoki kelajak bilan solishtirish, ehtiyotkor umumlashtirish va besh qadamli kengaytirishdan foydalaning. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir javob kamida ellik soniya davom etadi, takrorsiz va besh qadamning kamida to‘rttasi aniq eshitiladi.

quiz.why_uz: ‘Due to’ dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi; ‘because’ dan keyin to‘liq gap kerak.
‘Result from’ sababni bildiradi: stress ortiqcha ishdan kelib chiqadi.

quiz.q: Fewer jobs mean less spending, ___ hurts local shops.
quiz.why_uz: Oqibatdan keyingi oqibat uchun to‘g‘ri tartib: which in turn.

quiz.q: Choose the correct sentence about change.
quiz.why_uz: Hozirgacha davom etgan o‘zgarish present perfect bilan: have become.

quiz.q: By 2040, most cars ___ electric, in all likelihood.
quiz.why_uz: Kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtgacha tugagan o‘zgarish — future perfect.

quiz.q: Which sentence uses 'would' correctly for the past?
options: People would have more free time.
My grandfather would walk to work every day.
We would live in Samarkand in 1990.
She would be tall as a child.
quiz.why_uz: ‘Would’ faqat takrorlanadigan harakatlar uchun; holat uchun ‘used to’ ishlatiladi.
Umumiy ma’noda sanalmaydigan va ko‘plik otlar artiklsiz keladi.

quiz.q: Which phrase refers to old people as a group?
quiz.why_uz: The + sifat butun guruhni bildiradi: the elderly, the young.
‘Admittedly’ qarama-qarshi fikrni tan olish uchun ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Which is the most careful generalisation?
options: All young people are addicted to phones.
Young people tend to spend a lot of time on their phones.
